en_title: Mafia 2 and Mafia 3 Could Be Set for PS5 and Xbox Series Upgrades After Definitive Editions Leak Online
cn_title: 《四海兄弟2》《四海兄弟3》或将推出现世代升级版
subtitle: 评级信息先曝光
opus_summary: ESRB评级信息显示，《四海兄弟2》和《四海兄弟3》可能推出PS5及XBOX Series升级版。两作此前已在上世代主机推出决定版，新版本或将升级画面，而非从头重制，具体内容尚未公布。

paragraphs.en: Mafia 2 and Mafia 3 are coming to PS5 and Xbox Series consoles with some prettier graphics, according to an ESRB rating. Both games are rated Mature 17+ by the board, with each title featuring violence, nudity, and so… many… slurs.
paragraphs.cn: 根据ESRB评级信息，《四海兄弟2》和《四海兄弟3》将以画面升级的版本登陆PS5和XBOX Series。评级机构将两款游戏均评为「成熟级17+」：两作都有暴力、裸露内容，还有……大量侮辱性用语。

paragraphs.en: Previously, Mafia: Definitive Edition released for modern consoles in September 2020. A full-blown, ground-up remake of the original 2002 game, it acted as a great starting point for people jumping into the series for the first time. Mafia 2 and 3 Definitive Editions already exist for the last-gen consoles, so these listings presumably relate to current-gen upgrades that will, hopefully, include 60fps gameplay, rather than full-blown remakes.
paragraphs.cn: 《四海兄弟：决定版》此前于2020年9月登陆当时的现世代主机。这款游戏从零开始彻底重制了2002年的初代作品，很适合第一次接触该系列的玩家入门。《四海兄弟2》和《四海兄弟3》的决定版已经登陆上世代主机，因此这次的评级信息大概对应的是现世代升级版，而非彻底重制。希望它们能支持60帧游玩。

paragraphs.en: Publisher 2K recently released the Mafia: The Omertà Collection, which includes all the Definitive Editions alongside Mafia: The Old Country Definitive Edition. This launched alongside a PS5 and Xbox Series update to Mafia: Definitive Edition that seems likely to be replicated for Mafia 2 and 3.
paragraphs.cn: 发行商2K最近推出了《四海兄弟：缄默法则合集》，其中收录了该系列的所有决定版，包括《四海兄弟：故乡》决定版。合集推出的同时，《四海兄弟：决定版》也获得了PS5和XBOX Series升级。看来《四海兄弟2》和《四海兄弟3》可能也会迎来类似升级。

paragraphs.en: Interest in the series is at a new high following the release of Mafia: The Old Country earlier this year. A prequel story set at the height of the mob’s power in Italy, it followed the series’ template of plonking players into an open world that serves as a backdrop to the story, rather than a character in it.
paragraphs.cn: 《四海兄弟：故乡》于今年早些时候发售后，玩家对该系列的关注度再创新高。这部前传的故事发生在意大利黑手党势力鼎盛时期，沿用了系列一贯的做法：让玩家置身开放世界，但这个世界是故事的背景，而非故事中的一个角色。

paragraphs.en: IGN’s Mafia: The Old Country review scored it an 8/10, and called the game an “effective return to the linear and tightly story-driven format of the original Mafia and Mafia 2.” Mafia 3 split critics at launch because it leaned into its open world and made players complete repeatable missions to capture territory and progress the story. Amazing soundtrack, though.
paragraphs.cn: IGN为《四海兄弟：故乡》打出8分（满分10分），认为它「成功回归了初代《四海兄弟》和《四海兄弟2》那种线性、紧凑的故事驱动模式」。《四海兄弟3》发售时则让评论界意见不一，因为它更侧重开放世界，玩家必须反复完成任务，才能夺取地盘并推进剧情。不过，配乐确实精彩。

paragraphs.en: Hangar 13 president Nick Baynes previously told IGN that Mafia and GTA — despite sharing a parent company — exist in two separate camps. “I think that genuinely at the studio, we've got our own path,” Baynes said. “It genuinely never ever comes up in conversation as a touchpoint or steering our strategy or anything like that.”
paragraphs.cn: Hangar 13总裁Nick Baynes此前告诉IGN，尽管《四海兄弟》和《GTA》同属一家母公司，两者走的却是不同路线。Baynes说：「我真觉得，我们工作室有自己的路要走。我们讨论时真的从来不会拿《GTA》作参照，也不会让它影响我们的策略或其他决定。」

paragraphs.en: The ESRB posting doesn’t give much away, besides rehashing themes you’d expect from a game series named after an organized crime group. It’ll be interesting to see which side of GTA 6 ’s release date this November these Definitive Editions end up. Because while the games are fairly different, the audience only has limited disposable income and that choice has probably already been made if the games land anywhere near each other.
paragraphs.cn: ESRB公布的信息并未透露多少内容，除了一些以犯罪组织命名的游戏系列自然会涉及的题材。值得关注的是，这两款决定版最终会在今年11月《GTA6》发售之前还是之后推出。毕竟，两者虽然差别不小，玩家可自由支配的钱却有限；如果发售时间太接近，玩家可能早已决定把钱花在哪一边。

paragraphs.en: IGN just put out a big GTA 6 interview with Rockstar North studio head Rob Nelson , in which we spoke to him as he played a section of the game in front of us. Nelson spoke about its approach to open world design, and creating a game where “just existing” is a viable playstyle, living in Vice City and playing it almost like a life simulator.
paragraphs.cn: IGN刚刚发布了一篇关于《GTA6》的长篇专访。Rockstar North工作室负责人Rob Nelson在我们面前游玩了一段游戏，并接受了采访。他谈到了游戏的开放世界设计思路：玩家可以生活在罪恶都市，几乎把游戏当成生活模拟器来玩，单是「在这个世界里生活」就可以成为一种玩法。

paragraphs.en: It’s a very different approach to Mafia, in which the open world is simply a backdrop to the story. Still, isn’t it great that we live in a world where both approaches are viable and we get to experience it all?
paragraphs.cn: 这与《四海兄弟》的做法大不相同：在后者的游戏中，开放世界只是故事的背景。不过，两种做法都行得通，我们也都能玩到，这不是挺好吗？

paragraphs.en: A Mafia 2 and Mafia 3: Definitive Edition announcement is likely imminent, either way. My best guess would be The Game Awards this December, with a launch early next year. While you wait to find out, check out IGN's in-depth feature, 25 Years of Mafia Video Games: An Oral History .
paragraphs.cn: 不管怎样，《四海兄弟2》和《四海兄弟3》决定版或许很快就会公布。我猜最有可能在今年12月的游戏大奖上亮相，并于明年年初推出。等待消息期间，不妨看看IGN的深度专题《四海兄弟游戏25年：口述历史》。
